description: Queue a manual retest that checks whether a finding is still exploitable, when enabled for the organisation. Requires explicit user confirmation, spends credits and requires write permission. Available for findings in REPORTED, ACKNOWLEDGED, MITIGATING or OPEN_FOR_RETEST status with no retest already queued or running. Acts as the API key creator. Results are recorded in finding retest history.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: request_finding_retest
title: Request a finding retest
